qualification_limits: Runtime UNKNOWN_NO_RECEIPTS_REVIEWED_NO_EXECUTION; source-only acceptance is not compilation, runtime, security certification or qualification evidence.
File log/proc fixtures establish specific actual filesystem effects/readback only; live journald/live host proc and durability are not qualified.

Collector HTTP loopback uses injected views; it does not qualify live NATS/TerraBase measurement. Direct recorders and byte-buffer Export/Import remain unit; RouteRTT mixed preserves local sampler/history/JSON blocks.

Session fixture directly invokes repository-vendored upstream NATS server (go.mod replace ./third_party/nats-server) and external nats.go loopback client. It does not call natscell.Start or qualify production TLS/auth/distributed replicas/Vault/signature services.

Synthetic fault hooks preserve delegated real operations where specified; context/deadline/internal queue assertions constrain the same cleanup scenario. No actual host/network outage or process runtime was executed.
